tools.name: list_apis
tools.description: List the public MCP servers. Each server is one API.

tools.name: search_endpoints
tools.description: Search paid endpoints by id, title, description, or path. Optional api is a product slug or title.

tools.name: describe_endpoint
tools.description: Return the input schema, example, path, and price for one paid endpoint. This does not run the endpoint.

tools.name: call_endpoint
tools.description: Call one paid POST endpoint by id. Unpaid calls return 402 and do not run. Payment settles only after a successful result.
